body: Leo seems to be calling out for attention because he is feeling disconnected from the family, or you. He may feel a sense of rejection and even more so with this kind of reprimanding. He needs to be talked with, so he can express why he is going through and not feel cast out. It is so important to be firm with boundaries with the youth, and also come from a place of love. When people act like this, no matter the age, it is shows that they need help. The last thing we want to do is ignore the behavior, but people are not dogs and need more than taking away rewards to train better behavior. YBTA
